goal: Maximize useful-work duty cycle without paid API or always-on user PC while preserving single substantive authority and durable monotonic state.

layers.target_latency: predecessor ACTUAL END + exactly 1 minute (60 seconds) due plus measured provider delivery/startup delay
layers.mechanism: Normal close mutates only this SAME MAIN recurring RRULE DTSTART to exact observed ACTUAL END + 1 minute (60 seconds) and live-verifies it. Local mutation success is not delivery success; generation-matched eligible BOOT_STARTED is required.

layers.target_latency: next natural hourly recurrence after a lost shifted wake
layers.mechanism: Recurring RRULE remains enabled. A later occurrence reads fresh GitHub and repairs forward without a replacement actor.
Accept early/late wake jitter when authority can be claimed safely; fence only duplicate/stale/destructive overlap.
Not activated while P0-B SAME MAIN provider semantics are still being discriminated.

nonnegotiable_invariants: GitHub main is durable source of truth
duplicate wake never implies duplicate substantive side effect
same MAIN canonical remains enabled until program terminal or explicit operator stop
normal close requires live exact ACTUAL END + 1 minute (60 seconds) SAME MAIN verification
local live schedule verification alone never proves fast successor delivery
generation-matched eligible successor bootstrap is required for delivered-fast-path evidence
premature invocation cannot consume or overwrite a still-pending fast due
same MAIN recurring RRULE is the cold fallback
Watchdog is disabled standby and not a normal dependency

capability_evidence.epoch84_delivery_failure: Next eligible bootstrap 08:18:39 KST was 58 minutes 10 seconds (3490 seconds) after 07:20:29 KST, consistent with natural-hourly cold fallback.
capability_evidence.epoch85_premature: Invocation 08:28:42 KST was 1 minute 9 seconds (69 seconds) before pending 08:29:51 KST due; it was fenced and the pending due restored.
capability_evidence.epoch86_delivery_failure_reproduced: No eligible bootstrap occurred at restored 08:29:51 KST. Next eligible bootstrap was 09:29:53 KST, 1 hour 0 minutes 2 seconds (3602 seconds) late, reproducing missed shifted execution.
capability_evidence.standards_prior_art: RFC 5545 models DTSTART as the first recurrence instance and FREQ=HOURLY as an hourly recurrence anchored from DTSTART, but that representation does not guarantee this provider dynamically re-enqueues an imminent occurrence when a running recurring automation is mutated.

current_blocker: Inter-turn idle time and useful-work duty cycle, not second-level scheduler exactness.
next_test: Run the relay normally and measure useful-work duration versus inter-turn idle gap. Accept harmless provider jitter; only intervene when it materially reduces duty cycle or violates single-authority safety.
